transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google launches Genie 4, a real-time world model with native audio and realism for research preview, confirmed by The Hindu.
Confirmed by WSAU: China proposes new artificial intelligence export rules to restrict overseas access to advanced models and technology.
Anthropic warns that U.S. immigration policy could harm its artificial intelligence talent recruitment, reported by Fortune.
New artificial intelligence benchmark shifts top spot to Claude Opus 5.5 and widens the open-weight gap to 12 points, reported by Startup Fortune.
Moonshot AI launches Kimi K3.1 Pro to boost financial and coding capabilities amid export rules and data concerns, reported by The Star.
